LanguageData.RKU_Radio.label: Ratkin Underground Radio
LanguageData.RKU_Radio.description: Ratkin Underground radio. Through this radio, you can interact with the partisan forces. The partisans' attitude, the radio station's functions, and the events/quests that will be triggered are determined by the current goodwill level of the partisans. When reaching certain upper or lower limits (in increments of 25), it is necessary to interact with the partisan leader to expand the goodwill range.
